## Details

<a id="unused_fc04"></a>
### [`unused_fc04`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_fc04.asm#L6) `$FC04-$FC3F`

*data*

Nothing reads these bytes. $fc04-$fc07 hold the $00/$ff fill pattern of RAM after power-on, $fc08-$fc3f are 0. Build V 05 05 87 has the fill pattern in all of $fc04-$fc3f.
